idee_recherchee.texte: At the centre of a black hole, the equations of general relativity break down into a singularity of infinite density, which shows that our current theories cannot fully describe what happens at extreme gravity.

titre_video: Scientists Are Freaking Out Over Space Time (It's Not Real)
titre: L'isolement des derniers trous noirs dans un univers en expansion
resume: In perfect darkness near absolute zero, expansion leaves each black hole alone in its own bubble of emptiness. Eventually they are too far apart to interact gravitationally, so a simple hello at light speed would take longer than the universe has existed.
texte: It is the loneliest possible existence. In perfect darkness, the temperature of empty space is so close to absolute zero that the differences is meaningless. No chemistry is possible, no [music] complex structures can form. As cosmic expansion continues, even these final black holes become increasingly isolated. The universe grows [music] even larger and colder, stretching space itself until each black hole sits alone in its own expanding bubble of emptiness. >> [music] >> The cruel mathematics of expansion mean that eventually black holes become so far apart they can no longer interact gravitationally. Each black hole becomes a universe unto itself, the only source [music] of gravitational disturbance in its local region of space-time. The concept of nearby [music] becomes meaningless. Your nearest neighbor is so far away that even if you could somehow communicate at the speed of light, a simple hello would take longer to reach them than our universe has existed. [music]
